episodes.synopsis: One day, suddenly, a girl who loves me appears ── In front of Oda Nobunaga, a descendant of Oda Nobunaga, a girl named Sai Rattan Return Butterfly appears. When she hears the story, she seems to be Nobunaga's Masamuro's rattan return butterfly himself ...
episodes.title: It’s Nice That My Wife Came

episodes.synopsis: Kichou is moving into Nobunaga's apartment. She does her best to persuade him that he should make a baby with her even though she's underage, and he tries to resist as best he can.
episodes.title: Nobunaga's Determination

episodes.synopsis: Kichou goes to school, where she meets another girl who's in love with Nobunaga. The two decided to have a competition in class to see who can convince him to sleep with them.
episodes.title: Going Back to School

episodes.synopsis: The group takes a trip to Inabayama Castle, where Kichou realizes for the first time that she is, indeed, from the past.
episodes.title: To Inabayama Castle

episodes.synopsis: A second girl appears from the past. This one is also underage, but she has the mind of a 29 year old! So it's legal...or is it?
episodes.title: Two People

episodes.synopsis: Now that both Kitsuno and Kichou are home with Nobunaga, it's time for fighting over who gets to take a bath with him!
episodes.title: Wash Your Back

episodes.synopsis: Anna tries her best to get Nobunaga to fall in love with her. Kitsuno follows him to school where things just get worse.
episodes.title: Third Person

episodes.synopsis: Hoshigaoka invites Oda out for a night of drinking. But it's actually an excuse to get him someplace isolated...
episodes.title: Fourth Person

episodes.synopsis: At Jitoku'in's demand, Nobunaga sucks on her breasts. He's excited, think that she'll be able to marry her. But her host strongly refuses...
episodes.title: I Like It

episodes.synopsis: Nobunaga discovers that one of his "wives" brothers is also a person from his past. And this boy is in love with him too...
episodes.title: Fifth Person!?

episodes.synopsis: Jitoku'in's breasts are bothering her again, and she wants Nobunaga to take care of it. But her host demands a more permanent solution.
episodes.title: Hope of Koun-in and Nabe

episodes.synopsis: The way to cure one of the ghosts is to give them what they wanted to have in their past life. But how does that work when one of them was a boy who wanted to sleep with Nobunaga?
episodes.title: My Wife Said She Wouldn't Go Home
